environment.description: Application deployed on Apache Tomcat 9.0.68 behind an nginx reverse proxy (proxy_pass only, no filtering). PostgreSQL 14 database with the application user granted SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE on all tables in the reporting schema. The JDBC connection uses the default PostgreSQL driver with allowMultiQueries-equivalent behavior (semicolons in queries are processed). No query-level firewall or SQL inspection layer between the application and database.

config.proxy: nginx 1.24 with proxy_pass, no ModSecurity, no request filtering
config.db_permissions: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA reporting TO app_user
config.network: App server has direct TCP connectivity to PostgreSQL on port 5432
